title: Zephyr: /sensors/location Observable notifications
description: Push notifications on position changes to observers
notes: Implemented RFC 7641 Observe support for Zephyr GET /sensors/location in the existing location module. Uses Zephyr's bounded observer registry with an explicit 3-observer cap, exact endpoint+token refresh identity, Observe cancellation, initial Observe response, and 24-bit sequence wrap. Added deterministic polling triggers for first fresh fix, >=50m movement, source/fix-freshness changes, and 300s maximum interval; stale/error/no-fix inputs are suppressed. Notifications are allocation-free SenML-CBOR, public-mode only; changing to non-public privacy cancels observers. Transient backpressure retries every 5s and drops an observer after 3 bounded retries; permanent failures drop immediately. Validation: clean qemu_x86 Zephyr rebuild passed; focused coap_location_beacon QEMU ztest 14/14 passed, including registry capacity/cancel, sequence wrap, movement/source/freshness/time triggers, privacy cancellation, and retry/drop; git diff --check passed. Shared CoAP/SenML build/server files were not touched.
